method: Conversation-backed RED evidence, static contract TDD, provider-free config audit, CRG changed-file review, and direct review of graph-uncovered files.

conversation_red_evidence.failure: A repository full-suite result and immutable pilot artifacts became stale after evaluator manifest and exception-path edits.
conversation_red_evidence.control: Error-path gate, stable-tree verification, and Artifacts Last.

conversation_red_evidence.failure: CRG reported HEAD matched its graph and zero test gaps while new evaluator/test files remained untracked and outside graph proof.
conversation_red_evidence.control: Use git status as a coverage ledger and directly review untracked, stale, or uncovered files.

conversation_red_evidence.failure: A local Codex CLI helper returned Access denied while file and app fallbacks remained usable.
conversation_red_evidence.control: Probe a preferred tool once, then use the bounded fallback until the environment changes.

conversation_red_evidence.failure: Repeated per-step reflection and status polling consumed context without changing decisions.
conversation_red_evidence.control: Reflect only at milestones, novel failures, and final handoff.

limitations: No fresh subagent pressure run was launched because the active session policy did not authorize delegation; the natural conversation failures are the RED baseline.
The full repository suite is intentionally deferred until the already-dirty Task 8 source is review-clean, avoiding a second stale full-suite run.
Codex configuration and skill catalog changes require a new task or app restart to become the active session catalog.
No live provider, corpus, index, ingestion, migration, evidence promotion, push, or paid service ran.
